items.content_text: Slash command that turns a topic into a full 60+ second house-style short: script with sources, spec, render, QA, then delivery.
items.summary: Slash command that turns a topic into a full 60+ second house-style short: script with sources, spec, render, QA, then delivery.

items.title: Short-video house style
items.content_text: The settled look for 60+ second vertical shorts: bold yellow hook over the photo, frosted text, moving layered background, synced one-line captions.

items.content_text: Reviews a rendered short and its spec against the house rules and returns pass/fail per rule with frame timestamps.
items.summary: Reviews a rendered short and its spec against the house rules and returns pass/fail per rule with frame timestamps.
